div.span:
Three lookup paths in EnterAoI decompile:
* primary map (this+0x18) — assert > 0, decrement
* secondary map (this+0x24) — decrement piVar6[4]+0x10
if 0 and not CEF_Remote: FUN_00c6a1e0 + CancelDeferredNotifications
* neither — LookupOrEmplaceDeferredEntitySlot(this+0x30, entityId) Source-doc override: the old RE doc said "increments reference count" — that is WRONG. The code DECREMENTS entity+0x10.
